name: virtual-space-mvp-harness
description: Local evidence-led planning, building and validation of playable 3D spaces, with a preserved Pearl Office V7 baseline.

interface.longDescription: Guide uploads and missing-data questions into a locked planning pack, then build and test a local first-person 3D space. Includes source evidence, browser diagnostics and portable CLI tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me turn my floor plan and reference materials into a planned, validated and playable 3D space.
